prompt: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to play outside.
One day, a small dog found a big bone in the garden. He was very happy.
The sun was shining and the birds were singing. It was a beautiful day.
Tim and his mom went to the store to buy some food for dinner.
The little boat sailed across the lake. The water was calm and blue.
Every night, the moon smiled at the children as they went to sleep.
The old tree in the park was very tall. Many animals lived in it.
After they played, they were tired. They sat down and ate some cookies.
Once upon a time, in a small town, there lived a kind old lady.
The end. They all lived happily ever after.
